## LLM022 Model call inside a scheduled or async method

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm022 |
| Turn it off | `LLM022: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM022` on the command line |

There is no request inside @Scheduled / @Async, so there is no conversation boundary: with ChatMemory you either read someone else's session or create a new one every time, and the context never lines up. A scheduled job should decide what to process and leave the model call to a path that has request context.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM022` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm022 -->

## What it looks like

A `@Scheduled` / `@Async` method body that calls a model client.

## How to fix

Fine when intended, but keep an eye on cost and rate limits and never share one conversation id across runs. If it is accidental, move the call back to the request path.
